title: Point One Deep Serve Setup (Michelle Grogan)
style: Latin-infused electronic dance track with a heavy reggaeton influence. The arrangement features a prominent, syncopated dembow drum pattern with a crisp snare and a deep, punchy kick. A bright, staccato acoustic guitar riff provides the melodic hook, often doubled by a sharp, percussive synth lead. The bassline is a sub-heavy synth that follows the kick pattern. Male vocals are delivered in a rhythmic, rhythmic-spoken style with occasional melodic flourishes. The track includes percussive accents like woodblocks and shakers. 105 BPM, G minor, 4/4 time.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[staccato acoustic guitar riff, woodblock percussion]
0-0-2 we begin
Serving the right court ready
Receiver three feet behind
Paddle up, split step waiting
[dembow drum pattern enters]

[Verse 1]
[male vocals, rhythmic delivery]
Serve goes deep to the back third
Why? Because deep serve buys time
Receiver pushed back six feet behind
Giving server time to come in
¡Vamos, vamos! Deep is gold
Uno, dos, tres, position bold
Receiver returns deep down center
Classic safe, smart enter
Deep, deep serve, deep, deep return
Deep, deep serve, watch and learn

[Chorus]
[synth lead doubles guitar riff, heavy sub bass]
Point one deep serve set up
Point one deep serve set up
Deepest time, deepest time
Point one deep serve set up
Point one deep serve set up
¡Vamos amigos! Play it prime

[Drop]
[instrumental section with heavy percussion and synth stabs]

[Verse 2]
Serve at back third, shut your low
Why? Because the drop is slow
Time to walk to the kitchen line
Let them lift the ball just fine
Uno, dos, tres, drop and walk
Mano blanda, no shock
Four quick steps to the line
Ready stance and you are fine
This point is about position
Not speed, not pace, not collision
Deep serve, deep return, drop and approach
Kitchen line is the coach

[Chorus]
Point one deep serve set up
Point one deep serve set up
Deepest time, deepest time
Point one deep serve set up
Point one deep serve set up
¡Vamos amigos! Play it prime

[Outro]
[drums drop out, acoustic guitar riff fades]
Deep serve
Drop and walk
Watch and learn
